name: StableAgent
description: StableAgent checks whether an autonomous software-engineering agent behaves the same way when the same issue is described in different words. It applies meaning-preserving transformations to SWE-bench Lite issues, runs the agent on the original and on every variant, and reports whether the outcome and the patch change. It ships a Streamlit GUI, a CLI and a replay mode that reproduces the ICSE 2027 pilot without an API key.
